verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote large and readable and uses the wide canvas, but the line grid no longer works: the green vertical and the purple horizontal stop short of the canvas edges and don't meet at the top-left, and the red rule now meets the green line in a corner, which turns the open edge-to-edge grid into a boxed frame. B is a shrunk copy of the original sitting in the middle of the canvas, with large empty dark areas on both sides. Its quote is small, the vertical attribution is close to illegible, the green stub floats, and the purple horizontal ends abruptly well before the right edge.
